# Amity Online

> India's UGC-approved online university offering flexible undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in business, computer science, and emerging technologies with industry partnerships and career support.

Amity Online provides accredited online degree programs ranging from bachelor's to master's levels, with specializations in fintech, AI, data science, and healthcare management. The platform emphasizes flexible learning, job placement assistance, and partnerships with industry leaders like Paytm.

## Key Topics

- UGC-approved degrees
- Online learning
- MBA programs
- Computer Applications (BCA/MCA)
- Financial Technology (FinTech)
- Artificial Intelligence
- Job placement
- Flexible scheduling
- Industry partnerships
- Scholarship availability
- EMI financing
- Career services
- Data Science
- Blockchain technology
- Study abroad pathways

## Flagship Degree Programs

- [Master of Business Administration (Online MBA)](https://amityonline.com/master-of-business-administration-online): QS-ranked 2-year online MBA with AI-powered learning and industry projects
- [Master of Computer Applications (MCA Online)](https://amityonline.com/master-of-computer-applications-online): 2-year online MCA with AI and blockchain specializations and industry partnerships
- [Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA Online)](https://amityonline.com/bachelor-of-computer-applications-online): Online BCA with software development focus for students and working professionals
- [Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA Online)](https://amityonline.com/bachelor-of-business-administration-online): 3-year UGC-approved online BBA with specializations and zero-cost EMI options
- [Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com Online)](https://amityonline.com/bachelor-of-commerce-online): UGC-approved online B.Com with finance, accounting, and ACCA accreditation

## Specialized & Partnership Programs

- [BCA in FinTech & AI (with Paytm Partnership)](https://amityonline.com/bca-fintech-ai-paytm): 3-year online BCA in FinTech & AI with Paytm partnership and job placement
- [MCA with Paytm Collaboration](https://amityonline.com/mca-fintech-ai-paytm): 2-year online MCA with Paytm collaboration, AI, and placement guarantee
- [MBA in Hospital & Healthcare Management](https://amityonline.com/mba-hospital-healthcare-management): UGC-recognized MBA in Healthcare Management with Medvarsity collaboration
- [BCA in Data Science](https://amityonline.com/bca-data-science): Online BCA with Data Science specialization in Python and Big Data analytics
- [BBA in Travel and Tourism Management](https://amityonline.com/bba-travel-and-tourism-management): 3-year online BBA specialization in Travel and Tourism Management

## Integrated & Dual Degree Programs

- [BBA + MBA Integrated Program](https://amityonline.com/bba-mba): 5-year integrated BBA + MBA program with leadership and global exposure
- [B.Com + MBA Integrated Program](https://amityonline.com/bcom-mba): 5-year B.Com + MBA integrated program combining commerce and management
- [BCA + MCA Dual Degree](https://amityonline.com/bca-mca): 5-year accelerated BCA + MCA dual degree in computer science
- [MBA Dual Specialization](https://amityonline.com/mba-dual-specialization): 2-year online MBA with dual specialization options for career advancement

## Emerging Technologies & Certifications

- [AI Certification Programs | Amity School of AI](https://schoolofai.amityonline.com): AI certification programs with ML, Agentic AI, and industry-specific training

## Student Support & Global Opportunities

- [Career Services](https://amityonline.com/career-services): Career guidance with AI resume builder, mock interviews, and job placement
- [Study Abroad Pathways](https://studyabroad.amityonline.com): Study abroad pathways to USA, France, Germany, and other international universities
